title: Kit
description: A Mentura kit (EE-071): an enhanced package, at platform/kits/<name>/kit.json. It extends one Naive package (automations, agent workflows, skills, connectors on top of it) or one framework command (an agent-run upgrade), and never replaces it. The framework reads this manifest as data and runs the kit's entry as its own process; it never imports platform code (schema/kits.mjs). Automations are triggers a venture turns on by listing the kit in naive.config.json kits; each runs only once the package it needs is complete (schema/triggers.mjs).

command.description: The framework command it extends, such as "upgrade --agent"

entry.description: The kit's program, relative to its folder, run as node <entry> <venture dir>

command.description: The agent it runs by default; MENTURA_AGENT_CMD replaces it

env.description: Environment variables it reads, by name

automations.description: Triggers the kit brings; each names the package it needs (needs)

use_model.description: The steps that call a model ("use model", S-9); empty when none does

checks.description: What decides whether the kit's work lands; always framework code
